damage_story: A localized rear southwest guest-wing failure destroys several rooms and part of the second floor while leaving the lobby, main stair and most corridor circulation readable.
environment_layer: collapsed gravel and masonry concentrated beneath the failed wing
occupation_layer: garbage accumulated in the central guest corridor
ghouls occupying a surviving second-floor room away from the lobby
invariants: front entrance, lobby, reception and main stair survive
multiple intact guest rooms retain sleeping and bathroom zones
rear fire escape remains available from the surviving second floor
